step_1_build_ability_power.rabadon_multiplier: 515 × 1.30 = 669.5 → 670 after the engine's display-level integer rounding  [S2, S9]

step_2_magic_penetration_floors_the_targ.evaluated: Base MR at level 18 across data/champions.json spans 52.1 (most squishies) to 75.35 (Sylas, the single maximum). 52 → max(0, 31.2 − 42) = 0; 66.85 → max(0, 40.2 − 42) = 0; 75 → 3.0. So for every un-itemised level-18 champion the post-penetration MR is 0 (Sylas alone reaches 3), i.e. the magic-damage multiplier m(R) = 100/(100+R) is 1.0000 (0.9709 for Sylas)  [S6, S7]
step_2_magic_penetration_floors_the_targ.consequence: Magic damage in this build is delivered essentially RAW. Post-mitigation magic numbers are therefore pinned to the wiki's raw rows.

step_3_what_a_10_point_4_delta_can_be.cinderbloom_bonus_factor: 120% crit damage = ×1.2 = +20% of the instance  [S1, S1b]
step_3_what_a_10_point_4_delta_can_be.implied_instance: 10.4 / 0.20 = 52.00 exactly (order-independent: amp and mitigation commute because mitigation is linear in raw damage  [S8])

search_over_magic_instances_with_AP_670.result: No magic instance — and no 2× or 3× tick group — equals 52.00. The smallest magic quantum (W tick) is 22.88-28.14, and 2× W ticks land on 45.76 / 48.39 / 51.02 / 53.65 / 56.28, straddling but never hitting 52.00. Because m(R) = 1.0 there is no resistance freedom left to bend any of these onto 52.00 either (the only non-unit multiplier available anywhere in the champion pool is Sylas's 0.9709, which would require a raw 53.56 instance that likewise does not exist).

physical_instance_that_does_equal_52_00.no_armor_penetration_in_this_build: None of Shadowflame / Void Staff / Rabadon / Stormsurge / Actualizer / Sorcerer's Shoes carries lethality or % armor pen  [S2]
physical_instance_that_does_equal_52_00.armor_100_is_the_ordinary_case: level-18 base armor rounds to 100 for a wide band of champions (Aurora 99.5, Kog'Maw 99.65, Yunara 99.8, Nunu 100.4, Zyra 100.4, Teemo 100.5, Vladimir 100.5)  [S4, S9]

step_3_what_a_10_point_4_delta_can_be.corroborating_signature_actualizer: Actualizer amplifies ABILITY damage only [S3] (15% + 0.5% per 100 bonus mana = 16.5% with its own 300 mana). Any ability instance that lost the Cinderbloom bonus would have carried that 1.165 factor and could not land on a clean 10.4; a BASIC ATTACK is not an ability and is untouched by it. The delta being exactly 0.20 × 52.00 with no 1.165 factor is itself evidence the affected instance was a basic attack.
step_3_what_a_10_point_4_delta_can_be.corroborating_signature_decimals: With AP = 670 every ability row lands on a .0/.5 decimal (650.5, 535.0, 685.0, 675.5, 192.0). A ×1.2 Cinderbloom crit on a .5 row produces a .6 tail (675.5 × 1.2 = 810.6) — matching the new total's 4969.6. Restoring a +10.4 basic-attack bonus returns the tail to .0 — matching the old total's 4980.0.

step_4_adjudication.sourced_rule: Cinderbloom amplifies MAGIC and TRUE damage only, by 20%, against targets below 40% maximum health  [S1, S1b].
step_4_adjudication.finding: The removed 10.4 is uniquely reconstructible as the 20% Cinderbloom bonus on ONE Cassiopeia basic attack (physical, 104 AD at level 18, mitigated to 52.00 by ~100 armor). It cannot be reconstructed as the bonus on any magic instance in Cassiopeia's kit at this build's ability power, because magic mitigation is floored at 1.0 by 42 flat + 40% magic penetration and no magic row or tick group equals 52.00.
step_4_adjudication.conclusion: The old total granted Cinderbloom to physical damage, which the cached wiki text and Riot description both exclude. The 10.4 downward move removes exactly that ineligible bonus, so the post-change value is the one consistent with the source.

limitations_and_residual_assumptions: The scenario tuple for 'cassiopeia_5champ' (champion level, ability ranks, enemy roster, fight mode/duration) lives in scripts/bench_coupled_optimizer.py, which R-18 forbids reading. The absolute totals 4980.0 / 4969.6 were therefore NOT reproduced end-to-end; the adjudication is of the 10.4 delta and its mechanism.

Assumes level 18 for both Cassiopeia and the primary target. This is not free-floating: level 18 is the only level at which the growth factor is exactly 1.0, which is what makes AD land on exactly 104 and the bonus on exactly 10.4 (level 17 would need target armor 92.3 to reproduce the same figure).

Assumes the primary target's displayed armor rounds to 100 and that exactly one basic attack landed while the target was below 40% maximum health (a two-auto reading would require 300 armor and is implausible for an un-itemised champion).

An alternative story — a Cinderbloom eligibility-window/threshold correction that dropped one amplified instance — is not excluded, but it lands on the same instance and the same direction: with Actualizer's ability-only amplifier in play, only a non-ability (basic attack) instance can produce an un-scaled 0.20 × 52.00 = 10.40.

'old_value_correct' would require the engine to have been correctly amplifying something it now does not; no magic or true damage instance available to this build reconstructs 10.4, so that branch has no arithmetic support. 'both_wrong' cannot be ruled out at the level of the absolute total (the total was not reproduced), but nothing in the cached sources indicates a second unrelated error, and the sign and exact magnitude of the move are correct.
